This is just coming as one string. Eg: abc
But it should come something like
/subscriptions/edf2cef4-bc47-4278-b4f8-cfc65f25dfd8/resourcegroups/abcd/providers/Microsoft.Maintenance/maintenanceConfigurations/mc_name

Maybe you should use something else instead of GEN-UNIQUE here

roleAssignment names need to be a giud seeded with principal, role and scope.
```
guid(variables('aadPodIdentityUserDefinedManagedIdentityId'), variables('readerRoleId'), [and whatever your scope is here (hard to read with all the nesting)])
```
Check the other roleAssignments in the template as well, they all need to follow the same pattern precisely.
I think I fixed them, including the one in the template

Remove the concat() from the guid() functions (That will change the seed)

"[concat('Microsoft.Authorization/', guid(resourceGroup().id), variables('readerRoleId'), parameters('aksClusterName'))]",

These need to be very precise in order to be unique and idempotent - the seed of the guid function must contain the prinicipal, role and scope.

principal = full resourceId (not name) of the managedIdentity or objectId of the principal
role = full resourceId of the roleDefinition - same as the property value in the resource body
scope = full resourceId of the scope
Fixed: role assignment name = guid(principalId, roleId, scopeId)
you should use a GEN-UNIQUE parameter
I tried it. It generated an invalid name that is over 15 characters. Can you please help fix this issue?
you can use GEN-UNIQUE-15 for example if you want to limit to 15 characters.
